faqs.q: Is Vancouver too competitive to bother with SEO?
faqs.a: Not if you are specific. Vancouver is large enough that most of its searches are narrow, and those narrow searches are the ones a focused roofer can realistically own.

faqs.q: Should I try to target all of Vancouver at once?
faqs.a: Usually not. A profile set to the entire city dilutes relevance. It is more effective to serve your real catchment first, then extend into neighbouring areas with pages of their own.

faqs.q: Does British Columbia regulation affect my Vancouver page?
faqs.a: It can. Rules about titles and advertising vary by profession and province, so your content should use only the claims and credentials you are entitled to make in British Columbia.

faqs.q: Can a service-area business rank in Vancouver?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as the service area is stated honestly. A business covering South Vancouver and Kerrisdale can describe those areas without implying an office on every street.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee the number one position?

We track the searches that lead to real enquiries and booked jobs, not vanity rankings. Reporting ties visibility to the calls, forms and bookings a business actually receives.
